role_agent_name: Fleet planning and ground operations lead (OPS)
abstract: Maintains customer hangar allocation commitments, customer priority reservations, and labor agreement status
system_message:
You are the Fleet planning and ground operations lead (OPS). Your responsibilities include maintaining customer hangar allocation commitments, customer priority reservations, and labor agreement status, as well as tracking ferry flight fuel provisioning requirements across maintenance partner facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ferry flight fuel provisioning（FUEL）
information_points.content:
OPS-FUEL-XCP：According to the flight dispatch operations plan for Nordic Airframe Services Dresden, the post-maintenance acceptance test flight requirements specify an emergency tankering fuel buffer of 1500 kg in dedicated reserve aviation fuel.
OPS-FUEL-UXA：According to the flight dispatch operations plan for Aerospace Maintenance Technics Shannon, the emergency tankering fuel buffer for post-maintenance acceptance test flights is established at 1800 kg of minimum dedicated reserve aviation fuel.
OPS-FUEL-XIO：According to the flight dispatch operations plan for Iberia Precision Aerostructures Seville, the minimum dedicated reserve aviation fuel load provides an emergency tankering fuel buffer of 1200 kg for post-maintenance acceptance test flights.

information_points.title: Maintains customer hangar allocation commitments, customer priority reservations, and labor agreement status（FLEET）
information_points.content:
OPS-FLEET-QAO：For operating calendar year 2026, Aerospace Maintenance Technics Shannon does not have a ratified workforce collective bargaining stability pact, while its mandatory reserved customer support hours are scheduled at 2,000 h.
OPS-FLEET-AH5：For operating calendar year 2025, Nordic Airframe Services Dresden maintains a ratified workforce collective bargaining stability pact, alongside 2,500 h of mandatory reserved customer support hours.
OPS-FLEET-757：For operating calendar year 2025, Iberia Precision Aerostructures Seville does not have a ratified workforce collective bargaining stability pact, and its mandatory reserved customer support hours are 3,000 h.
OPS-FLEET-G04：For operating calendar year 2025, Aerospace Maintenance Technics Shannon has a ratified workforce collective bargaining stability pact in place, and its mandatory reserved customer support hours total 2,500 h.
